en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 33 points at 24449
en.dek: The index ended at 24,449 after trading between 24,437 and 24,733, edging lower from Friday's close of 24,482.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed lower on Monday, finishing at 24,449 points, down about 33 points or 0.13 per cent from the previous session.
The index opened at 24,591 and traded in a range of 24,437 to 24,733 during the day before settling lower. Trading volume was around 1.9 billion shares.
Market participants cited mixed regional cues and ongoing concerns over global growth as factors behind the modest decline.

zh.headline: 恆指收市跌33點報24449
zh.dek: 指數全日高見24733、低見24437，最終收報24449點，較上日收市24482點微跌。
body: 恆生指數周一收市下跌，報24449點，較上個交易日跌約33點或0.13%。
指數開市報24591點，全日波幅介乎24437至24733點，收市時微跌。成交額約19億股。
市場人士指，區內消息好壞參半，加上對全球經濟增長的憂慮持續，令指數輕微回落。
